verdict.rationale: The IRS's online services, including Online Account, Business Tax Account and the Tax Withholding Estimator, hold or process user tax data, so in-product AI-generated insights is a fair question for this kind of service. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any AI-generated insights or suggestions. The Withholding Estimator is only a calculator, and the probes show no AI-facing surfaces (llms.txt and OpenAPI paths return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
